rows.en: <operator(19020,1)><speed(2)>We could simply ignore the <color(5)>New Federation<ce()>... <color(5)>Shin Dragon<ce()>'s right in front of us!
<operator(19020,1)><speed(2)>This makes it feel like we're protecting <color(5)>Shin Dragon<ce()> instead!!
<operator(19050,1)><speed(2)>I already explained it, didn't I.
<operator(19020,1)><speed(2)>So you're saying take down both. Fine, let's do it!
<operator(19010,1)><speed(2)><color(5)>Shin Dragon<ce()>... is waiting for me. Something will happen in this fight.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)><color(5)>Berkt<ce()>'s back again, huh...
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>That's right, we have to stop him here.
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>So stop hesitating. At least for now.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>But I don't know if it's right to keep fighting like this.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Talking with <color(4)>Renton<ce()>... We were never soldiers to begin with.
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>By fighting, I've hurt so many people. This is war... and I... never really felt it.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>Think about it. KLFs and mobile suits are manned. Take one down and the pilot dies.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>Did you think <color(4)>Gekkostate<ce()> was merely some surfing club?
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>...
rows.notes: Source row is an ellipsis only; rendered per brief.

rows.en: <operator(1040,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Renton<ce()>'s right... An ordinary guy like me, fighting a war and hurting people...
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Barrel<ce()>... pull yourself together. We have a battle ahead, you know?
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Faye<ce()>, aren't you scared of fighting?
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>Of course I'm scared. But I have something I want to protect. That's why I can fight.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Something you want to protect... like what?
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>Something obvious. As for what... figure it out yourself.
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>Captain <color(4)>Amuro<ce()>... The youngsters seem a little lost.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>Yeah... But this is a wall they need to get past too.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>If they can't get past this wall, they'd be better off leaving the ship.
<operator(25020,1)><speed(2)>So this is the famous <color(5)>Shin Dragon<ce()>.
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>It's huge, all right... don't go chickening out on me!
<operator(25020,1)><speed(2)>Hmph... don't lump me in with you.
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Renton<ce()> and <color(4)>Barrel<ce()>... they both look pretty troubled.
<operator(17070,1)><speed(2)>Everyone fears hurting others. Are you all right, <color(4)>Garrod<ce()>?
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>I... have something I want to protect. If it's to protect <color(4)>Tiffa<ce()>, I fear nothing.
<operator(17070,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Garrod<ce()>... thank you. Those words made me happy too.
<operator(17010,2)><speed(2)>Huh!? Th-that was... heh heh. This is embarrassing.
<operator(17020,1)><speed(2)>There's a lot of enemies this time.
<operator(17030,1)><speed(2)>Huh, what's wrong? Did you get scared or something?
<operator(17020,1)><speed(2)>Don't be stupid. There's no way that'd happen to me.
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Witz<ce()>, saying that is only the flip side of being nervous, you know?
<operator(17020,1)><speed(2)>Even you're teasing me now!? Tch... let's go already!
<operator(23020,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Renton<ce()>... are you all right...?
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>...
rows.notes: Source row is an ellipsis only; rendered per brief.

rows.en: <operator(23020,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Holland<ce()>... <color(4)>Renton<ce()>'s...
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Renton<ce()>, there's no time to hesitate. Out there, you're the only one who can protect <color(4)>Eureka<ce()>.
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>...I know.
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Gainer<ce()>, is your wound all right now?
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>Yeah... somehow. I've recovered enough to sortie again.
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>Ever since then <color(4)>Renton<ce()>'s gotten passive. It's a problem.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>Yeah... I wonder if he's okay.
<operator(21020,1)><speed(2)>Leave him be. That's how a man grows up. ...You too.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>I want to stop <color(5)>Queen<ce()>. That's why I'll fight!
rows.notes: 'Queen' = Cynthia Lane's online handle per character_names_021 (Gain Bijou entry).

rows.en: <operator(19020,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Go<ce()>, what do you mean <color(5)>Shin Dragon<ce()>'s waiting for you?
<operator(19010,1)><speed(2)>I don't know. But <color(5)>Shin Dragon<ce()> is calling me.
<operator(19030,1)><speed(2)>Just what's going to happen...?
<operator(19050,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Ryoma<ce()>, did you hear what <color(4)>Go<ce()> said earlier?
<operator(19040,1)><speed(2)>That guy was part of old man <color(5)>Saotome<ce()>'s plan from the start.
<operator(19050,1)><speed(2)>Dr. <color(5)>Saotome<ce()> meant to use <color(4)>Go<ce()> for something.
<operator(19050,1)><speed(2)>So does he have some secret for that purpose...?
<operator(19040,1)><speed(2)>We'll know the truth once that old man <color(5)>Saotome<ce()> shows himself...
<operator(14030,1)><speed(2)>So it's finally a showdown with that big lug.
<operator(14020,1)><speed(2)>Heh... this is finally getting interesting.
<operator(14010,1)><speed(2)>You call that interesting? What's wrong with you...

uncertainties.issue: 'Queen' renders Cynthia Lane's online-game handle per her glossary entry (character_names_021, medium-confidence source); no prior scene file uses this name to confirm in-corpus precedent.

meaning_fixes.before: Huh!? Th-that was... heh heh. Don't embarrass me.
meaning_fixes.after: Huh!? Th-that was... heh heh. This is embarrassing.
meaning_fixes.reason: Source '照れるな' uses the intransitive verb 照れる (to feel shy/embarrassed), which has no causative reading, so it cannot mean Tiffa is making Garrod embarrassed. In context (Garrod himself stammering right after being thanked) the na is a self-directed exclamation, not a command aimed at her. The old line invented an addressee/cause the source does not state.

meaning_fixes.before: Is Gainer's wound all right now?
meaning_fixes.after: Gainer, is your wound all right now?
meaning_fixes.reason: Source 'ゲイナーは傷、もう大丈夫なのか？' has Garrod addressing Gainer directly by name (topic marker wa), not asking a third party about him. Confirmed by the very next row where Gainer answers in the first person ('Yeah... somehow. I've recovered enough to sortie again').

meaning_fixes.before: So he's carrying some secret for that purpose...
meaning_fixes.after: So does he have some secret for that purpose...?
meaning_fixes.reason: Source line ends in か ('...やつにはあるのか……'), continuing Hayato's speculation from the prior row rather than asserting a fact. The old line dropped this uncertainty and stated it as settled.

checked_decisions: table1 slot264 'Queen' for Cynthia Lane's handle: accepted per orchestrator ruling; matches character_names_021 (Gain Bijou entry). No change.
table0 slot32/table1 slot220 ellipsis-only rows ('…………。'): rendered as bare '...' per existing note; left unchanged.

j/q rewording (mechanical, not a meaning change): table0 slot19 'just ignore'->'simply ignore', table0 slot31 'was just some surfing club'->'was merely some surfing club', table1 slot182 'is just the flip side'->'is only the flip side', table1 slot183 'let's just go!'->'let's go already!'.
